chapters.title: Static routes and exact matching
learning_goals: See the routing table as a (method, path) → handler map
Use a dict for O(1) exact lookup instead of scanning strings
Normalize paths: trailing slashes and method case

chapters.title: Path parameters: a rule is not a literal
learning_goals: Split paths into segments instead of comparing the whole string
Treat :id as a capture rule, not something you == against the request
Keep exact matching for static routes

chapters.title: Priority and wildcards
learning_goals: Static segments beat params, params beat wildcards
Use a specificity score to break ties

chapters.title: The middleware onion
learning_goals: Wrap the handler in a middleware chain instead of copying cross-cutting logic
See why use() registration order is the reverse of wrap order
Return 404 on a miss instead of raising

chapters.title: Assemble a runnable Mini Router
learning_goals: Build a tiny HTTP API from the Router of the first four chapters
Adapt an HTTP request into Request / Response
